_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Row text is not selectable but rename and tag inputs are. A conversation exists, row [data-conversation-id="{{ID}}"] ("the row"). The context menu is data-testid "conversation-context-menu"; its item "X" is the element with role menuitem named exactly X inside it (a "selector" scoping a "role"). "Select all text of input I" means what Playwright's selectText does: eval I.select() then I.focus(). Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The computed user-select of the row's ".conversation-title" is exactly "none", and so is that of its ".conversation-preview". 3. Right-click the row (click, button "right") and click the context menu's item "Rename". 4. The row's ".drawer-rename-input" has computed user-select exactly "text". 5. Select all its text; then eval document.activeElement.selectionEnd - document.activeElement.selectionStart must be greater than 0 (return the comparison, expecting true). 6. Press Escape. 7. Right-click the row and click the context menu's item "Edit tags". 8. The row's ".conversation-tag-inline-input" has computed user-select exactly "text". 9. Fill it with "selectable". 10. Select all its text; then eval document.activeElement.selectionEnd - document.activeElement.selectionStart must be exactly 10.
